name: Update 15 Backport
teaser: Why wait for 3.10.0 when you can degel now? Backports ALL weapons, clothing, armor, and attachments from the new EFT Update 15, all implemented exactly according to live EFT! Bot loadouts, world loot, and full localization included.
description_html:
Mod Info
Update 15 Backport

Find out more about what EFT mods I’m working on here!

https://trello.com/b/CONaHPTn/%E2%80%A6i-mods-by-rairaitheraichu

NOTICE: Not compatible with MightyCondor’s weapon backports (Desert Eagle and M60 mods). If you choose to switch to this mod, your items should safely carry over, but it has not been tested!

Want to support my work? Consider clicking the link below!

This mod backports the new items from EFT version 0.15 (SPT version 3.10.0) to 0.14 (SPT version 3.9.x).

The new weapons have proper presets, mastery, and all* attachments. All stats are identical to live.

The new weapons are: Desert Eagle (both .50AE and .357, all variants), SR-3M, UZI (all variants), and M60 (all variants).

All items are given the same trader requirements as live Tarkov, where possible (some barters needed to be changed - the new streamer items are not included). Otherwise, they are available on the Flea Market. All items have proper MongoIDs, meaning there will be no bugs regarding magazine presets, etc.

The “SR-3M”, “Desert Eagle (WTS)” and the “M60E6 (FDE)” variants are not available on the Flea Market (at least, without being examined first), as BSG intended. They can be found on certain bosses, albeit rarely. The other weapons will be found on bosses, raiders, cultists with the same rarity as live EFT. AI PMCs can also be found carrying the new weapons.

The “SR-3M” barter is unlocked at Prapor LL4 upon completion of the “Perfect Mediator” quest.

The items currently spawn in raid as loot, both in the world and in containers.

All clothing is ported, and is available from Ragman at LL2.

All helmets, rigs, headsets, etc are ported, with the proper armor panels. The layout for the rigs are *not the same as live*, but they are a close approximation.

The “DevTac Ronin ballistic helmet” barter is unlocked by completing “Corporate Secrets”, and the “Camelbak Tri-Zip assault backpack (MultiCam)” barter is unlocked by completing “Inventory Check”.

All new attachments for weapons (with the exception of the Makarov PM laser grip) are added and are available on every weapon/part they are compatible with in live (see “Compatibility” section below for more info).

All languages are properly localized.

No new features (bipods, mounting, animation variations) are added.

No new barter items are included. Some new trades that require the new barter items have been changed to a similar-valued requirement.

Not all attachments for the SR-3M are added, as some were redone by BSG for both the VSS and AS Val. The VSS and AS Val new animations are not compatible with the version of EFT 3.9.x is running on, and therefore can not be ported.

Assuming 3.9.x profiles carry over into 3.10.x, all of your items will carry over. You can safely discontinue using this mod for 3.10.0 and your new weapons/clothing/gear will carry over. Be aware the rig layouts for your new armor vests will be different in 3.10.0, so you will want to empty the rigs before updating to SPT 3.10+.

Compatibility

Realism: This mod does not contain any compatibility patches for Realism. If you’d like to make one, please do so and submit it to me so I can add it to the mod page and credit you! Please thoroughly test your patch, as I’m not familiar with Realism enough to test and ensure nothing is broken. EDIT: As of Realism 1.4.5, I’ve been told the new weapons are officially supported.

MC’s Desert Eagle/M60 port: Incompatible. Please choose either this mod or those. Writing a compatibility patch, with the way this mod works currently, would be far too time-intensive and likely still result in issues. The good news is, you should still keep your guns if you switch over to this mod (using the same IDs).

Other weapon/attachment mods: Depends on the mod. Try using a load order editor to let this mod load FIRST, so if another mod clones vanilla items as part of their process of adding new items, it’ll inherit these attachments as well. Otherwise, additional work would be needed to add these new attachments to other custom weapons. Unfortunately I can not do anything about this.

Known Issues
  • The M60 trigger group shows a white square icon when there is no pistol grip attached in the UI.
  • The Armored Vests do not have the same slot layout as they have in live EFT.
Bug Reports

If you encounter any issues, please feel free to contact me on Discord (RaiRaiTheRaichu).

You can leave a comment here, as well, but response time may be significantly longer as I do not usually check my inbox here often.

Please include any logs generated from the console as well to help me narrow down the issue.
